title: Urbex: Agentic Spatial Grounding for City-Scale 3D Scenes
abstract: arXiv:2610.18356v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: City-scale 3D grounding is commonly formulated as candidate ranking, which requires precomputed instance proposals and becomes inefficient in large outdoor scenes. We propose Urbex, an agentic vision-language framework that instead casts grounding as active spatial search. Urbex represents a city-scale 3D scene as an interactive multi-view environment, allowing a VLM agent to query landmarks, zoom into local regions, render oblique views, and commit a grounded bounding box. We optimize this tool-use policy with reinforcement learning on CityRefer, using smooth localization rewards and lightweight shaping rewards for efficient exploration. Experiments show that Urbex achieves the best Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer, supports candidate-free grounding without ground-truth boxes, and is substantially faster than the strongest city-scale ranking baseline. Zero-shot results on STPLS3D-Refer further indicate improved cross-scene robustness.

translated_title: Urbex：面向城市级3D场景的智能体式空间定位
translated_abstract: 城市级3D定位通常被表述为候选排序问题，这需要预先计算的实例提案，并在大型户外场景中变得低效。我们提出Urbex，一个智能体式的视觉-语言框架，它将定位任务转化为主动空间搜索。Urbex将城市级3D场景表示为交互式多视角环境，允许VLM智能体查询地标、放大局部区域、渲染斜视图，并提交定位的边界框。我们在CityRefer数据集上通过强化学习优化这一工具使用策略，采用平滑定位奖励和轻量级塑造奖励以实现高效探索。实验表明，Urbex在CityRefer上取得了最佳的Hit@1和IoU指标，支持无需地面真值边界框的无候选定位，并且比最强的城市级排序基线快得多。在STPLS3D-Refer上的零样本结果进一步表明其跨场景鲁棒性有所提升。
tldr: Urbex提出一个智能体式视觉-语言框架，将城市级3D定位从候选排序重新建模为主动空间搜索，通过强化学习优化工具使用策略，在CityRefer上取得最佳性能且速度显著快于排序基线。
en_tdlr: Urbex is an agentic vision-language framework that reformulates city-scale 3D grounding as active spatial search rather than candidate ranking, achieving state-of-the-art Hit@1 and IoU on CityRefer while being substantially faster than ranking baselines.
